name: Rainy Window Hours
description: A rainy window onto a city that follows the time of day: dawn, grey daylight, golden hour, sunset, dusk and a neon night, with drops running down the glass and over the glassy clock.

steps.script: const names = ["night","dawn","day","golden","sunset","dusk"].map((id) => window.__sc[id]); const e = await addElement('IMG', { src: names[2] }); e.name = 'Scene'; e.src = names[2]; e.images = names.slice(2).concat(names.slice(0, 2)); e.handle = 'scene'; e.x = 0; e.y = 0; e.show = 'normal'; return names.length
const n = project.elements.length; ['Hour','Colon','Minute'].forEach((nm,i)=>{ project.elements[n-3+i].name = nm + ' Aod'; }); return 1

const names = ["night","dawn","day","golden","sunset","dusk"].map((id) => window.__dr[id]); const e = await addElement('IMG', { src: names[2] }); e.name = 'Drops on glass'; e.src = names[2]; e.images = names.slice(2).concat(names.slice(0, 2)); e.handle = 'drops'; e.x = 0; e.y = 0; e.show = 'normal'; return names.length

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gRain = 'Rain'; let n = 0; for (const e of project.elements) { if (['Drops on glass','Rain outside'].includes(e.name) || /^Running drops/.test(e.name)) { e.group = 'gRain'; n++ } } return n
document.getElementById('btnPruneImages').click(); return project.images.length + ' images left'
